incbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 401/403 from edge-auth-gw (eu-west-1). Spike concentrated on /v1/chat and /v1/embed routes. Paging @jordan (oncall)

jordan: on it. looking at logs now. can someone confirm customer impact?

maya: seeing ~15% 401s for requests proxied through auth edge. subset have X-Service-Token header with repeated values, replay pattern.

eli: confirmed. repeated X-Service-Token values across different client_ids and regions. suspicious replay + possible leaked tokens. found S3 uploads to a staging prefix: s3://redwood-staging-logs/2026-03-17/edge-auth.log.gz

sam: can we throttle or block IPs? top src IPs: 54.38.12.5, 3.120.45.90, 18.194.22.1 — looks like a small botnet. will prepare WAF rules.

liz: temporary mitigation option: add edge header-scrub rule to drop X-Service-Token for non-internal hosts and strict-validate remaining tokens. will push to canary.

anna: customer-side: cust-alpha and cust-beta reported intermittent auth failures; CS has one P1 ticket open. tagging for updates.

jordan: handoff — maya you take lead for live mitigation; eli you own token rotation plan; sam handles IP blocks/WAF; liz watches canary rollout; rita/legal on notification.

maya: acknowledged. starting playbook "auth-leak-contain" now — will coordinate runs and timeline.

eli: rotation plan (high level): 1) identify exposed service-accounts (svc-auth-proxy, svc-ingest) 2) stage new secrets in SecretsManager 3) rotate keys and update services 4) invalidate old tokens from authz cache. ETA for first rotation: ~12 minutes.

eli: CLI snippet for rotation (note: replace ARNs):
```
aws secretsmanager update-secret-version-stage \n --secret-id arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:123456789012:secret:svc-auth-proxy \n --remove-from-version-id CURRENT \n --move-to-version-id NEXT
```

sam: adding WAF blocks for the three IPs and an iptables drop on edge nodes. deploying in ~2m. will post ruleset id.

liz: canary rule deployed to 1/6 edge nodes. observed 60% drop in 401 rate on canary. monitoring for false positives.

maya: note — found one rotated token inside an older s3 archive copy. starting S3 object review and immediate revoke of any exposed keys. rita, legal/privacy FYI.

rita: acknowledged. please preserve all artifacts and timeline. I'll open an incident report doc and coordinate notification cadence + regulators if needed.

anna: sending interim customer note: "We're actively mitigating an auth issue; no evidence of PII exfiltration at this time. We'll update within 2 hours." will include postmortem link after closure.

jordan: status check in 10. owners: maya (mitigation), eli (rotation), sam (blocking), liz (deploy/canary), rita (legal), anna (customer comms). add others as needed.

maya: scheduling rotation windows starting +15m. will post rotated secret ARNs and confirm authz-cache purge per service.

eli: after rotation, we will run authz-scan to invalidate reused tokens: `curl -XPOST https://internal-api/auth/invalidate -d '{"token":"..."}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer admin'`

sam: WAF & iptables blocks are live; blocking telemetry shows repeat hits from those IPs.

liz: promoting header-scrub rule to 4/6 nodes now; will promote global if no FP within 5m.

maya: promoting globally in 2m if canary stays green. uploading logs snapshot to the incident folder.

incbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (header-scrub, WAF blocks, canary). 401/403 rate down to baseline on promoted nodes. Severity -> triage. Next steps: full key rotation, forensics, postmortem. :white_check_mark:

jordan: great work. keep rotation updates in this thread. I'll start the timeline and schedule a 1hr postmortem after rotations complete.
